name: adams_metals_fw305_core_2013.hndarray
description: Adams Lab ICP-MS element concentrations (64 isotopes, three instrument runs) of the FW305 sediment core (2013)

value.string_value: Sediment core taken during the installation of well FW-305 (Oak Ridge FRC, Background A; well completed 2013-05-29), 54 sections from 0.5 to 26.08 ft below ground surface. ICP-MS by the Adams Lab (University of Georgia), acquired 2013-07-26 to 2013-07-31 (acquisition method 072613.m)

Each section's digest was read three times in succession (replicate 1 to 3); the values are the three readings, not an average. Concentrations are mg of element per kg of dry soil: the Adams Lab template's ng/g values (instrument reading in ppb x dilution factor 499 / dry soil mass) divided by 1000, the unit of the other Adams Lab sediment bricks. The dry soil mass of each section is on the sample dimension. The workbook does not describe the digestion

Each entry of the molecule dimension is one monitored isotope of an element (molecular weight = isotope mass), read with or without collision gas (presence of helium, as in the Adams Lab core pilot bricks; the workbook says only 'Gas Mode (ORS)'). Elements monitored at more than one isotope, or in both gas modes, have several entries; each is that isotope's estimate of the element's concentration, and they can differ where an isotope suffers interference (for example cadmium at masses 106 and 111)

A reading of zero in the workbook is stored as below detection (blank concentration, below = true). The workbook subtracts no blank and gives no detection limits. Never above zero: technetium atom (mass 99)

Not stored: three masses the workbook assigns to no element (15, all zero; 33; and 44, which follows calcium-43 at 2.1 to 2.8 times its value), the internal standards (Li, Sc, Y, In, Tb, Bi), and the workbook's averages, standard deviations and 'Dwayne' sheet, which derive from these readings
Source: ENIGMA Google Drive, Static Loaded Preprocessed sorted 07272013ORNL+Batch 2 ZeroAvgOnlyORNL.xlsm (sheets Run Optional 1 to 3)
